reviewScope.summary: Independent review of ProgressPal Epic E final successor candidate 4172339ad302dd1fbabffa5286d5f55be376eb43 and its unchanged payload tree a63fc9fc8041bab59880c89e47c4032595efe9f1. The review reconstructed the standalone Git bundle; verified candidate, root/src/payload identities; reviewed the programme-scoped XP and result/recovery path, Programme #2 source/export delta, runtime-isolation evidence and mutation controls, candidate-bound automated validation, Home/Campaign Map and changed-copy screenshots, residual risks and Lessons Learned/process controls. A post-candidate external-source closure changed only pilot/render_calibration.js and its generated study-calibration document from 'setup clinics' to 'setup troubleshooting'; the three inputs consumed by ProgressPal remained byte-identical, so candidate 4172339 and this payload tree remain the exact reviewed product bytes.
evidence: Final successor review package ProgressPal_EpicE_FinalSuccessor_4172339_r2.zip, SHA-256 f1b076f57b90bd31649f754cdc246c52f84d7eebddcc209e3d50d549630d19a4; manifest and standalone Git bundle independently verified.

Candidate identity: commit 4172339ad302dd1fbabffa5286d5f55be376eb43; root tree 65d04141751f1235454f4092b4d63680f4b85c8b; src tree 582d6181636d3f7ecadeaead161b19d5c0c838ff; review payload tree a63fc9fc8041bab59880c89e47c4032595efe9f1.

Successful candidate-bound pre-review validation on unchanged candidate: 1,991 unit/integration tests passed with 0 skipped; 145 E2E passed with 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 flaky and 0 retries; lint, format, typecheck, build, bundle budget, circular-dependency check and dependency audit passed; gate diagnostics were empty except the expected independent-review binding refusal.

The earlier validation attempt on the same immutable candidate is preserved as failed environmental evidence: 144 of 145 E2E completed with 0 test failures before Playwright global timeout; it is not treated as a pass and the successful rerun does not erase it.

Runtime-isolation closure: adversarial learner Python can remove sys.modules sentinels and reacquire Pyodide bridge modules, proving the sentinels are advisory; under the exact production worker/CSP, awaited pyfetch, open_url, _api.loadBinaryFile and loadPackage probes dispatched zero same-origin or cross-origin requests, while unhardened positive controls and two boundary-weakening mutations produced observable failures/requests. Permanent isolation regressions ran again in the final candidate's E2E suite.

Programme #2 source identity at candidate freeze: pilot.json SHA-256 5ece045cc6bea695d729b5ca974f0da1f96a3eff715d1a8e2c348874f4380ddd, 1,121,807 bytes; all 291 exercise ids/hashes and programme counts remained unchanged by the final owner-copy tranche.

Source-closure supplement ProgressPal_EpicE_4172339_SourceClosure.zip, SHA-256 180f075ee599589d909ed2b5c0a09eaa8c88771c431ebde5420f5b15514cef46; manifest independently verified. The active study renderer/output now contain 'setup troubleshooting' and no clinic/klinikk naming; pilot.json, 04_SKILL_GRAPH.json and 06_SEMESTER_1_STRUCTURE.json remain byte-identical to the candidate hashes, so no ProgressPal product byte or payload-tree identity changed.

The Programme #2 authoring pipeline is not represented as globally green: the stale protected-input-verifier mutation harness and the frozen participant-baseline/evidence-snapshot block remain disclosed non-green/skipped governance checks. A later unnecessary broad manual source-pipeline rerun hung in the unrelated delayed-retrieval probe verifier after all source-generation checks relevant to the one-word closure had passed; that failed attempt is preserved and is not acceptance evidence.

Owner-approved copy is present in shipped Programme #2 assets: 'Det er en av tingene du får forklart i delen Feilsøking av oppsett.' and 'fire vanlige Git-problemer du kan løse selv'. The X-klinikk/clinic naming convention is absent from current active learner-facing/product-authoring and generated product data; remaining literals are limited to enforcement or explicitly frozen/historical evidence outside the live product path.

Representative 390/1280 Home, Campaign Map and changed-copy screenshots were independently inspected. They support the bounded Epic E UX corrections; mixed-language shared-shell presentation remains known deferred release-quality debt rather than an undisclosed defect.

adversarialFindings.description: An earlier Epic E implementation could persist a terminal correct evaluation result while silently dropping its qualifying XP when award planning failed, leaving durable learner progression inconsistent.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The final candidate performs result persistence and qualifying XP planning/award in one post-attempt transaction. A planning failure aborts that transaction, leaves the already-durable attempt unresolved, and idempotent recovery later records the result and XP exactly once. Failure-injection and recovery tests discriminate the old behavior and remain green in the final candidate.

adversarialFindings.description: The original Python runtime proof treated mutable sys.modules sentinels as if they were the isolation boundary; adversarial learner Python can remove those sentinels and reacquire Pyodide bridge modules, so the original proof was insufficient for the no-network/no-durable-storage contract.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The final runtime evidence tests the actual capability boundary in the packaged production worker under production CSP. Reacquired bridge modules expose an empty jsglobals; JS evaluation/storage/network routes are denied; awaited same-origin and cross-origin Pyodide network primitives dispatch zero observed requests. Unhardened controls prove observability, and two boundary-weakening mutations make the permanent regression fail. Runtime product bytes are unchanged from the reviewed closure and the regression tests run in the candidate-bound E2E suite.

adversarialFindings.description: Programme #2 contained rejected X-klinikk/clinic naming and two awkward learner-facing Bokmål sentences across active authoring/generated material.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The final source-first regeneration uses the owner-approved Bokmål wording and plain troubleshooting/practice labels; shipped/current product data contains no clinic/klinikk naming. A post-candidate source-closure removed the last active study-renderer occurrence ('setup clinics') without changing any of the three Programme #2 files consumed by ProgressPal, so candidate 4172339 remains the exact product payload under review.

adversarialFindings.description: The Python isolation proof is capability- and Pyodide-version-specific rather than a general proof for arbitrary future Pyodide/browser-worker versions.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted risk for this release. The evidence pins Pyodide 314.0.7 and permanent adversarial regression tests act as a tripwire. A Pyodide, worker-global or CSP architecture change must invalidate and rerun the isolation review rather than inherit this conclusion automatically.

adversarialFindings.description: Programme #2 source governance is not globally green: a pre-existing protected-input mutation harness is stale and the frozen participant-material baseline/evidence-snapshot block intentionally diverges from evolving product-authoring output.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted as bounded source-governance debt. The candidate and handoff explicitly disclose both checks rather than calling them green; current product-authoring/export checks relevant to Epic E pass, frozen archives remain preserved, and these governance repairs are outside the Epic E product scope.

adversarialFindings.description: The successful E2E validation used 752 seconds of a 780-second global timeout, after an earlier run on the same immutable candidate timed out with 144 of 145 tests completed and zero test failures.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted as test-infrastructure/runtime-headroom risk. The failed attempt is preserved, the timeout was not loosened, and the unchanged candidate subsequently passed 145/145 with zero failures, skips, flakiness or retries. If the later native release gate times out on an otherwise idle machine, stop and reassess rather than silently raising the ceiling.

adversarialFindings.description: Programvareutvikling learner content is Bokmål while substantial shared ProgressPal/RPG shell navigation and status vocabulary remains English; avatar, selective reset, broader localization and related polish are also deferred.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted as explicit post-Epic-E release-quality debt rather than hidden incompleteness. Epic E preserves Bokmål curriculum quality and multi-language architectural compatibility without broadening into a localization/avatar/data-lifecycle redesign.

retrospective.summary: Independent review finds no open P0-P3 blocker in product candidate 4172339 / payload a63fc9fc8041bab59880c89e47c4032595efe9f1. The prior P1 data-integrity and runtime-proof issues are resolved with discriminating tests/evidence. The final owner-copy and clinic/klinikk sanitation are source-closed without changing ProgressPal product inputs or candidate bytes. Known Pyodide-version specificity, source-governance debt, E2E timeout headroom and mixed-language shell debt are explicit P3 accepted risks. Decision: proceed to owner acceptance and, only after this review evidence is deliberately bound to the exact payload, the repository-native release gate. This decision does not itself authorize push, merge, tag, release or deployment.
